chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea, then both copies of Water's Edge, all targeting Seapunk. At 8 Charge, that deals 13, then 6, then 6 damage, for 25 total against 22 HP.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Thoma - Crimson Guard for its 3 Block, but it would deal only 8 damage and leave Seapunk alive.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up the 3 Block from Thoma - Crimson Guard, but defeated Seapunk instead of leaving it alive to make the telegraphed attack.
q4_different_intent: No. With enough affordable damage to defeat Seapunk this turn, a different enemy intent would not have changed my line.
